remarks: Welcome to 103 Ledge Ln in the desirable Belltown area of Stamford, CT. This charming home features five spacious bedrooms, two well-appointed bathrooms, and two sets of washers and dryers, ideal for accommodating a large extended family or multigenerational living. Recently updated with new flooring throughout, the residence offers a fresh and modern feel. Nestled in a quiet neighborhood, the home provides tranquility and comfort with its versatile living spaces. The expansive layout includes generous rooms. Outside, a beautifully landscaped yard provides a serene retreat. Conveniently located near all that Stamford has to offer, 103 Ledge Ln is the perfect place to call home.
